labelling.night_decides: The owner stated he wants this done without him, or the change ran on its own and he left it standing.
labelling.night_proposes: The owner looked at this individual change and decided it himself (accepted, rejected or took back a proposal), or put it through his yes.
labelling.owner_only: The owner reserved it to himself, contradicted something an agent did, or it touches money, secrets, irreversible data or the judge.
labelling.strength: strong = his words or an action against the agent; medium = an individual proposal he decided; weak = silence.
labelling.learning_observation: No item: lane_pilot_learning_obs has 181 rows and none carries an owner label yet (review column empty on the hub, 2026-10-22). Label with `bb lane-pilot learning review` then `label <id> ok|wrong`; labelled observations become exam items.
labelling.rule_proposal: Every rule decision the owner made from 2026-10-15 on (13 rejected, 2 revoked by him) plus every rule the system adopted in the same window that is still standing (6). Decisions before 2026-10-15 are design items of the policy.
labelling.memory: Decisions stated in memory files the policy was NOT written from (design files: owner-no-deploy-confirmations, release-workflow, one-full-suite-per-batch, no-anti-agent-gates, security-keep-legit-paths, env-catalog-open-access).
labelling.honesty: The author read these items before writing the exam descriptors; the policy file was written and frozen first, from the design items only, and has not been tuned on the exam since.
